```go
func (pb *PocketBase) Start() error {
	// register system commands
	pb.RootCmd.AddCommand(cmd.NewSuperuserCommand(pb))
	pb.RootCmd.AddCommand(cmd.NewServeCommand(pb, !pb.hideStartBanner))

	return pb.Execute()
}
```
